_comment: Loose daypart guardrails, in server-local time (TZ set on the dj container). `hours` is a [start, end) range in 24h clock; a window that wraps past midnight (like night, or the weekend techno slot) is written as start > end and handled that way in code -- the early-morning tail is attributed to the day whose evening started it. `days` is optional: a list of weekdays (0=Monday .. 6=Sunday, i.e. Python's datetime.weekday()) the entry applies to; omit it (or leave unset) for every day. Entries are matched top to bottom, first match wins -- so more specific day/hour overrides belong above the generic fallback dayparts. `mood` weights are matched against the same six-dimension mood vector AudioMuse-AI stores per track (happy/sad/aggressive/party/relaxed/danceable) - values are relative targets, not required to sum to 1, and are only used when `artists`/`genres`/`tags` don't already supply a pool (or as the fallback when that pool comes up empty). `artists` and `genres` pull straight from Jellyfin instead of the mood catalogue. `tags` instead go through AudioMuse-AI's own genre/vocal-type classifier (stored, confusingly, in its `mood_vector` column, distinct from the 6-dimension mood used above) -- its vocabulary mixes genre-ish labels ('Hip-Hop', 'electronic') with vocal-type ones ('female vocalists'), the same one the AudioMuse-AI song map colors points by, and is a good way to say 'this vibe, whoever's actually in the library' rather than a fixed artist list. `artists`/`genres`/`tags` on the same entry are all pooled together. `exploration` (low/medium/high, default medium) loosens how far from the mood target the adaptive picker is willing to wander -- higher means more variety, lower means it sticks closer to the target. Only used for mood-based picks.

dayparts._comment: Daily 16:00-17:00 theme hour, a different one each weekday -- picked from AudioMuse-AI's genre/vocal-type classifier tags (see the top-level comment), sized by how many tracks in the library actually carry each tag as of 2026-09-04: Hip-Hop 1917, jazz 1811, metal+heavy metal 2335, punk 728, 80s 382, House 516, ambient+chillout 5191.
dayparts.name: theme_hour_monday_hiphop
